name: JW Marriott Hotel Mexico City
positioning: Luxury city hotel in the heart of Polanco (officially JW Marriott Hotel Mexico City Polanco), with a wellness floor whose outdoor pool overlooks Chapultepec Park
best_for: Travelers who want a Polanco base near Chapultepec Park and Avenida Presidente Masaryk
Guests who value wellness, with a spa, an outdoor pool and daily yoga and Pilates

facts.text: The hotel is set in the heart of Polanco, one of Mexico City's most celebrated neighborhoods.
The hotel is moments from Chapultepec Park, Paseo de la Reforma and Avenida Presidente Masaryk.
Polanco is also home to the Museum of Anthropology and the National Auditorium.
A dedicated Wellness Floor has an outdoor pool overlooking Chapultepec Park.
The hotel's spa, Organic Spa Mx, offers body scrubs, facials, massages, in-suite massages and scalp and hair treatments.
The Wellness Floor offers daily yoga and Pilates classes.
A complimentary fitness center is located on the 7th floor.
Room types include Junior Suites, Corner Suites and a Master Suite.
Tahona Mezcal Room is an intimate mezcal tasting room with hand-crafted varieties from maestros mezcaleros from across Mexico.
Archibald is an American-style steak house with high-end wines.

considerations.text: This is a city hotel; the closest airport is Benito Juarez International Airport.
Pets are welcome, with one pet allowed per room.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects its luxury positioning in an upscale neighborhood.
